nodes.label: GLUE System Architecture
nodes.rationale: Core reference for how GLUE works: the website, GLUE folder (JSON store), GLUE Home (Tauri app), GLUE Cloud, analysis, DJ libraries, and the website's layout

nodes.label: GLUE Home (Tauri 2 tray app)
nodes.rationale: The user's computer's engine: runs the library analysis natively in Rust, syncs DJ libraries, streams songs to other devices over WebRTC, signs updates

nodes.label: Native Analysis Engine (glue-audio)
nodes.rationale: Rust port of browser analysis for GLUE Home, held byte-for-byte to TypeScript by golden tests, handles DSD conversion and profile-specific quality verdicts

nodes.label: Engine DJ Two-Way Sync
nodes.rationale: Merges cues, loops, grids three ways; writes while Engine DJ closed; backs up before writes; clashes asked in Prepare; playlists, order and song relinking also synced

nodes.label: DJ Library Live Sync
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home follows collections' DJ libraries every 5 seconds by date, reads changed ones, finds new ones in music folders; page shows state and asks for refresh

nodes.label: GLUE Folder (JSON Store)
nodes.rationale: User's data: profiles, collections, music folders, playlists, analyses, events, backups, all in JSON files, no database; sharded tracks and analysis for atomic writes

nodes.label: GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: Optional Cloudflare account service: holds account's collections, profiles, devices; signaling via Durable Object; no music data; admin panel and daily purge

nodes.label: Shared Collection
nodes.rationale: One collection same on every signed-in device; merges per field with clash detection; GLUE Home syncs it; one computer's id writes that computer's parts

nodes.label: Background Analysis Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Queues inside 'songs at a time': user-asked songs first, then new tags, library songs, background thumbnails; passes retried, failures saved with reason after third try
